title: O momento certo para oferecer um serviço extra

brief.idea:
Write every slide in European Portuguese (pt-PT, not Brazilian).

Headline: O momento certo para oferecer um serviço extra

Subhead: Não é quando o cliente marca. É quando lhe entrega o carro.

Cover these beats, one per slide:
- No formulário, um extra é só mais uma decisão
- Com o carro à frente, muda tudo
- Combine o preço antes de começar
- Deixe os extras prontos a juntar
- Depois veja quais é que valem a pena
- O que fazer esta semana

Close with a call to action asking the reader to DM the keyword EXTRAS.

Do not invent statistics, numbers or percentages — use only facts stated above.

Lead with the reader's problem, not with the product.

parseUser:
BRAND VOICE: Quietly confident and aspirational. Speaks directly to the studio owner — 'your clients', 'your bookings' — with the calm authority of someone who has already solved the problem. Evocative fragments preferred; hype avoided; urgency earned by proof.
PHOTOGRAPHY: this brand is carried by its images — most slides that show a place, a product, a person or a result should ask for one.
DO: Address the studio owner directly ('your', 'you'); Lead with the outcome, not the feature; Let a single gold italic phrase carry the emotional weight; Use fragments and sentence-case for elegance; Pair a concrete number with a brief human consequence
DON'T: Exclamation marks; Buzzword stacking ('revolutionary', 'game-changing'); Passive voice; More than ~28 words of body copy per slide; ALL-CAPS body text
SLIDES: exactly 0 — one per SLIDE PLAN entry, in that order. Do not add a slide the plan did not ask for, and do not merge two.
BRIEF: Write every slide in European Portuguese (pt-PT, not Brazilian).
